text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten so late, maybe I'll just buy 
something from the store for lunch... Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!? The two of you who are always 
bickering having a sandwich picnic outside 
together!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-I must observe this up close!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Neither of them are here?! No waaaaay!

Not only did Agnes Digital lose sight of 
the Umamusume, she ended up missing lunch 
altogether...
